question: Explain this support pilot to a teammate. What happens, and what should we measure before expanding it?
facts: Three volunteers draft answers to repeated internal support questions.
They keep the approved handbook separate from the facts in each new ticket.
An exact repeat can reuse a completed answer within the configured reuse window.
A person reviews the facts and suitability before sending any answer.
No customer outcomes, savings figures or review-time measurements have been recorded yet.
